# Ewanbot (إيوان بوت) — AI Real Estate Advisor & Egypt Compounds Intelligence

> Ewanbot (إيوان بوت) is an AI-powered real estate advisor and data-grounded property platform dedicated to the Egyptian real estate market. It covers 663+ verified compounds and 2,800+ residential & commercial units across New Cairo (Fifth Settlement), Sheikh Zayed, New Administrative Capital, 6th of October, Mostakbal City, North Coast (Ras El Hekma, New Alamein), Ain Sokhna, El Shorouk, and Red Sea resorts — with instant installment calculations, head-to-head compound comparisons, and zero cold-calling spam.

## Key Capabilities & Tools
- **AI Real Estate Advisor (المستشار العقاري الذكي):** Grounded conversational search in Arabic and English backed by verified compound prices, payment plans, and market metrics.
- **Egypt Compounds Directory (دليل كمبوندات مصر 2026):** 663+ verified compound landing pages with starting prices, average price per sqm, minimum down payment %, installment years, and sample units.
- **Head-to-Head Comparison Arena (حلبة مقارنة الكمبوندات):** Direct comparison of any two compounds by price/sqm, down payment, monthly installment, and payment duration with instant PDF report export.
- **Budget & Gold vs Real Estate Calculator (حاسبة الميزانية والذهب):** Match available down payment and monthly budget to real Egyptian compounds and compare real estate ROI against bank CDs and gold.
- **Egypt Real Estate Market Index (مؤشر إيوان لأسعار العقارات):** Monthly city-by-city average price/sqm, developer reliability scores (EGX & delivery track record), and real estate market disclosures.
- **Direct Owner Listings (اعرض وحدتك للبيع مجاناً):** Owners can list apartments, villas, or land plots directly for serious buyers without spam sales calls.
